notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Raising your three-storey tower — drawers below, bins on top.

result.note: A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

parts.name: Leveling foot
parts.use: Puts a captive nut on a face so a bought leveling bolt can take the weight, which is how a cluster gets level on ground that is not.

parts.name: Rod socket
parts.use: Stands a round tube up off a cell face, so a mast, a stake or a conduit riser is carried by the cluster.

parts.name: Ground anchor
parts.use: Pins a cell to the ground through a hole sized for a stake or a heavy screw, for a build that has to stay where you put it.

parts.name: Cable comb
parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.

parts.name: Grab handle
parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.

parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.

parts.name: Pipe socket
parts.use: Bolts a glue-in socket for 3/4 in pipe to any face that takes a bolt-on: a side flat, or the lid of a bolt cover. Solvent-weld a pipe into it with PVC primer...

parts.name: L bracket
parts.use: Back plate on the flat, shelf on top, gusset underneath: the part to bolt on when something has to stick out sideways and stay level.
